title: Ahmed, AI Voice Receptionist

## Overview
Ahmed is a conversational AI voice agent that handles clinic calls in real time. It answers questions and books appointments using natural speech. The portfolio includes a recording of a demo call.

Built with VAPI and ElevenLabs for voice, integrated with n8n and Groq for real-time call handling and appointment booking.

title: Ahmed, AI Voice Receptionist
text:
## Details
Project: Ahmed (AI voice agent)
Problem it solves (draft): Handling booking calls by hand is slow and easy to miss. Ahmed answers the call, books the appointment, saves the record and sends the confirmation email automatically.
Hardest technical part (draft, edit if wrong): Making the whole flow reliable end to end, from call to booking to saved record to confirmation email, with no manual step. All automated tests pass.
Solo or team: Solo
Timeline: About 2 days
Supervisor feedback: None
GitHub link: Private (no public repo)
Mobile app link: Not applicable
Architecture: n8n workflow. Incoming call -> conversation -> booking -> save the record -> confirmation email sent automatically

title: Hisab Kitab

## Overview
Hisab Kitab is an AI-powered personal finance tracker with monthly income and expense tracking, WhatsApp voice-note logging and LLM-generated narrative email reports. Live: https://hissab-kitab-eosin.vercel.app/

title: Hisab Kitab
text:
## Stack
Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, NextAuth.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Groq.

title: Hisab Kitab
text:
## Details
Project: Hisab Kitab
Problem it solves: Most budgeting apps are complicated. Hisab Kitab is built around one idea, "ek paycheck, ek mahina": track what is left of this month's money. Logging is easy by voice or WhatsApp, including in Urdu, Roman Urdu or English.
Hardest technical part: A deprecated LLM model started returning 404s and broke voice entry, WhatsApp and reports at once. Fixed by moving all model names into one config with an env override and a fallback model. Also: accurate voice entry from mixed Urdu / Roman Urdu / English speech.
Solo or team: Solo, end to end
Timeline: About 2 weeks to build end to end; updates and patches continue
Supervisor feedback: None (do not reuse Dr. Akmal's quote here, it is about TripFusion)
GitHub link: https://github.com/JAWADAHMAD-18/Hissab_Kitab
Mobile app link: Installable PWA today. Native mobile app coming soon. No store link.
Stack: Next.js + TypeScript, MongoDB Atlas, NextAuth, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Recharts, Groq (Whisper + LLM), Brevo, WhatsApp Cloud API, Vercel.

title: TripFusion
text:
## Overview
TripFusion is an AI-assisted travel platform for booking flights, hotels and custom packages with smart recommendations. It was Jawad's final year project. Live: https://tripfusion.vercel.app/

title: TripFusion
text:
## What Jawad built
Token-based authentication with access and refresh tokens, Google OAuth, Redis, real-time chat with Socket.io, and a rule-based chatbot API. He also built a companion React Native (Expo) mobile app that uses the same backend as the web app.

title: TripFusion
text:
## Stack
React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Redis, JWT, Google OAuth, Socket.io, React Native, Expo.

title: TripFusion
text:
## Details
Project: TripFusion
Problem it solves: Planning a trip means juggling many sites for travel data and itineraries. TripFusion brings travel search and AI-assisted trip planning into one platform.
Hardest technical part: Pulling large datasets from a third-party travel API (Amadeus) and keeping the app fast. A Redis caching layer lets large responses load in seconds.
Solo or team: Solo, end to end
Timeline: About 2 months for the initial build (weekends, alongside university classes) as a final year project, improved afterwards
Supervisor feedback: "The UI and UX are both good, but the backend optimization is excellent. Even large API data loads within seconds, with good use of Redis." Dr. Akmal, FYP Supervisor, Department of Computer Science, IUB (permission granted)
GitHub link: https://github.com/JAWADAHMAD-18/FYP-project
Mobile app link: A React Native app runs on the same backend. No store or Expo link provided, so hide this field.
Stack: React 19, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Redis, Socket.IO, Amadeus API, Gemini AI, JWT, Google OAuth, React Native.
